'''2014 Worlds Day 2 Angelo Consoli DS Wookiee Slaving Operation''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Angelo Consoli]] at [[2014 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name Slavers.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Wookiee Slaving Operation / Indentured To The Empire|VB8-D-wookieeslavingoperation-pre.gif}}
* '''Username:''' DrevithShadow
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
